description: Register a standing watch on an endpoint: a JSONata predicate over $body, $headers, and $query, evaluated server-side against every future capture. Use it when the user wants specific events flagged without polling payloads. Inputs: name, predicate, an optional label, and endpointId. Matches are counted, and a label is stamped onto matching captures so the digest ByLabel group and the list_captures label filter pick them up. A predicate may NOT reference $secrets. Example predicate: $body.type = "charge.failed".

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to use the claimed or only endpoint.

label.description: Label stamped onto matching captures (drives digest ByLabel + drill-down).

name: register_watch
title: Register watch
